sections.Profile:
"Messalina" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1966. Designed for two players, it features mechanical reels for scoring.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Historical Figure, Two player, Original Theme
